s1.syndrome_frame: Rapidly growing caruncular lesion with ulceration
salient_findings: Amelanotic, pedunculated mass with ulcerated surface
Large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
key_facts: 4-week history of a rapidly growing left caruncular lesion
Medical and ocular histories were unremarkable
Ocular examination findings were normal except for the caruncular lesion
No evidence of PAM (primary acquired melanosis)
Specimen measured 8 × 6 × 5 mm with a 4-mm ulceration
Necrotic tissue on the surface of the specimen
Solid tumor with an inflamed crust on its surface
Large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
Positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A
Significant number of cycling cells shown by Ki-67 proliferation marker
Sentinel lymph node biopsy findings were negative
Conjunctival and orbital biopsies revealed no tumor

shortlist.label: Malignant melanoma of the caruncle
shortlist.why_kept: Rapidly growing, ulcerated, and anaplastic cells with mitotic activity, positive for melanocytic markers

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Ulcerated lesion with rapid growth, although less likely given positive melanocytic markers

shortlist.label: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Rapid growth and ulceration, but less likely due to specific melanocytic marker positivity

shortlist.label: Merkel cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Rapid growth and ulceration, but less likely due to specific melanocytic marker positivity

shortlist.label: Basal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Less likely due to rapid growth and ulceration, but still a consideration

shortlist.label: Adnexal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Possible given location and rapid growth, but less specific findings

shortlist.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Less likely, but could present with rapid growth and ulceration

shortlist.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Less likely, but could present with rapid growth, although specific findings do not strongly support this diagnosis

raw.rationale: The presence of a rapidly growing, ulcerated, and pedunculated mass with positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A, along with a high proliferative index shown by Ki-67, strongly supports the diagnosis of malignant melanoma of the caruncle.

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Lack of evidence for squamous cell differentiation and no mention of keratinization

rejected.label: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
rejected.why: No indication of sebaceous gland origin or lipid production in the tumor cells

rejected.label: Merkel cell carcinoma
rejected.why: No mention of neuroendocrine differentiation or positive staining for Merkel cell markers

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: No evidence of basaloid cells or palisading, and the tumor's growth pattern does not suggest basal cell carcinoma

rejected.label: Adnexal carcinoma
rejected.why: The tumor's characteristics do not suggest origin from adnexal structures such as sweat glands or hair follicles

rejected.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
rejected.why: No evidence of mucin production or squamous and mucous cell components

rejected.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
rejected.why: No indication of cribriform or tubular patterns, and no mention of perineural invasion
